The person behind the design

Your business.
Your story, online.

RP Hunt Design creates thoughtful websites for small businesses, shaped around who you are and what you do. From the first impression to the next step, every detail has a purpose.

I’m Ryan Hunt, a website designer based in Chicago. I started building computers at 11, then worked in a small PC repair shop before becoming a software engineer at Capital One. From there, I moved into product management at Kraft Heinz and now Fresh Thyme Market.

RP Hunt Design is something I’ve wanted to build for a long time: a way to help people bring new ideas to life. Whether you’re launching a business or modernizing an established one, I’ll help you create an online presence that reflects who you are and opens up new opportunities.
